definition: Estimates Robot Glacier Surveyors readiness from component maturity.

title: Robot Glacier Surveyors Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Robot Glacier Surveyors operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Robot Glacier Surveyors installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 43409 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where ice bots monitoring, surveyor logistics redundancy, or crevasse navigation maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Robot Glacier Surveyors Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Robot Glacier Surveyors: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Robot Glacier Surveyors — robots monitoring glaciers and ice sheets.

Phase 1 — Prove (ice bots): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (surveyor logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (crevasse navigation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (climate sensors): surveyor hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cryosphere-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
